svg.title: The live feed's new signals against the controls
svg.desc: False new signals per 100 targets: what the feed's own admission rule passes on light curves with every signal destroyed, against the live feed. Wilson 95% intervals; a target is 2 sectors. Live feed, “new” signals: 15.8 per 100 targets (3 over 19 targets; 5.5–37.6); Control: block-scrambled light curves: 12.9 per 100 targets (20 over 309 star-sectors; 8.5–19.6); Control: flux-inverted light curves: 11.0 per 100 targets (17 over 309 star-sectors; 6.9–17.3); Real light curves of TOI hosts: 3.2 per 100 targets (5 over 309 star-sectors; 1.4–7.5). Expected from noise alone (the worse control): 12.9 per 100 targets, so the live feed's “new” signals are consistent with noise. A fix is proposed in the benchmark report and not applied. Source: docs/results/benchmark_real_tois.json (held-out half, feed-level table), commit d6f8ae8.
